verses.text: The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, will you judge her? Will you judge this city of murderers? Then make her aware of all her disgusting practices.
Say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: You are a city that brings doom on itself by spilling blood within its walls and making itself unclean by making idols.

You have become guilty because of the blood you have spilled, and unclean because of the idols you have made. You have brought your days to an end, and the end of your years has come. So I will make you a disgrace to the nations and a joke to all the countries.
Those near and far will make fun of you, you city with a bad name, full of turmoil.
Look how each of the leaders of Israel in you uses their power to spill blood.
In you people treat their fathers and mothers with contempt. In you they oppress foreigners and mistreat orphans and widows.
You have despised my holy things and dishonored my Sabbaths.
In you are people who tell lies to get others killed. In you are those who eat at the mountain shrines and do shameful things.
In you men have sex with their father's wife. In you they force themselves on women during their period, when they are unclean.
In you one man commits a disgusting act with his neighbor's wife. Another shamefully makes his daughter-in-law unclean. Another forces himself on his own sister, his father's daughter.
In you people take bribes to have others killed. You charge interest and make a profit from loans. You cheat your neighbors to get rich. And you have forgotten me, says the Lord GOD.
Look, I strike my hands together in anger at the dishonest profits you have made and at the blood spilled in you.
Will your courage hold up, or will your hands still be strong, when I deal with you? I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it.
I will scatter you among the nations and spread you throughout the countries. I will put an end to your uncleanness.
You will be dishonored in the eyes of the nations. Then you will know that I am the LORD.'"
The LORD's message came to me:

"Son of man, the people of Israel have become like slag to me, the worthless waste left over when metal is purified. All of them are like copper, tin, iron, and lead left in a furnace. They are only the slag left from silver.
So this is what the Lord GOD says: 'Because you have all become slag, I am going to gather you into Jerusalem.
As people gather silver, copper, iron, lead, and tin into a furnace and blow the fire hot to melt them, so I will gather you in my anger and fury. I will put you inside the city and melt you.
I will gather you and blow on you with the fire of my fury, and you will be melted inside the city.
As silver is melted in a furnace, so you will be melted inside the city. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have poured out my fury on you.'"
The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, say to the land, 'You are a land that has not been cleansed or rained on in the day of my anger.'
Her prophets plot together like a roaring lion tearing its prey. They devour people. They take treasures and precious things, and they make many widows in the land.

Her priests break my law and dishonor my holy things. They do not teach the difference between what is holy and what is ordinary, or between what is unclean and what is clean. They shut their eyes to my Sabbaths, so that I am dishonored among them.
Her leaders are like wolves tearing their prey. They spill blood and kill people to make dishonest profits.
Her prophets cover up these sins with whitewash. They see false visions and tell lying predictions. They say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says,' when the LORD has not spoken.
The people of the land cheat and steal. They mistreat the poor and needy and oppress foreigners, denying them justice.
I looked for someone among them who would build up the wall and stand before me in the broken places on behalf of the land, so that I would not have to destroy it. But I found no one.
So I have poured out my anger on them and destroyed them with the fire of my fury. I have brought down on their own heads what they have done," says the Lord GOD.
